|lore=Help you I can, yes. For 800 years have I trained Jedi. Judge me by my size do you? Mm? And well you should not! For my ally is the Force... and a powerful ally it is.
|game_text=Deploy on Dagobah I must, but move elsewhere I may, yes. When the mentor, 1 to training destiny I add. Where present am I, battles and attacks happen not unless present a Dark Side character of ability > 3 there is. To attrition, immune am I.
|joke=The lore and game text are written in Yoda's object–subject–verb word order, as in "Deploy on Dagobah I must". See [[Jokes#Yoda|Jokes]].

|rulings=* [[Yoda]]'s battle and attack prevention text affects both players.
* 'Where present am I' means [[Yoda]] must be present at the location (not inside a starship or enclosed vehicle). This also means it could only work at a site.
* Effective game text: Deploys only on [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]]. When the mentor, adds 1 to training destiny. While present at a site (and no opponent's character of ability > 3 present here), battles and attacks may not be initiated here. Immune to attrition.
